messages:
Jordana (product): FYI customer Helios Health filed a formal request to onboard a 30B‑scale model for private deployment. Requirements: on‑prem, INT8 quantized variant, <200ms p50 latency for single-turn queries, and HIPAA data handling. They also want regression checks vs current baseline (redwood-13b-v1). Link to PRD: https://confluence.internal/helios-model-ask :wave:
Mia (applied-ml): Thanks. Can we get the precise model name / weights they want? And main workloads (chat assistant vs extraction vs embeddings)? That determines eval suites and batching profile.
Alex (customer-success): Helios said they prefer "phoenix-30b-chat" (weights from open repo) and will primarily use Q&A + form extraction. Throughput low (50 reqs/min) but strict latency at p50. They asked for private deploy with KMS and audit logs.
Sam (swe): Quick triage proposal: 1) Validate license/redistribution for phoenix-30b; 2) Try reference INT8 quant on a staging GPU node; 3) Run our freshness & safety checks; 4) Run perf/eval harness against redwood-13b-v1 baseline. I can do (2) if someone shares the S3 path.
Mia (applied-ml): I sketched a bring‑up checklist: 
- Intake: model name, weights URL, license, intended workloads, customer SLAs 
- Safety: run toxicity + PII detector, check alignment to allowed list 
- Eval: run QA suite (200 prompts), extraction suite (50 forms), and a small safety promptset (100) 
- Quant: baseline fp16 perf, then GPTQ int8 -> measure p50/p95, memory, and output shift 
- Regression: compare EM/F1 and hallucination rate vs redwood-13b-v1; require <3% degradation overall, <5% on extraction F1 
- Ops: containerization, KV cache checks, KMS integration test 
I can author the eval sets but need the model weights.
Jordana (product): Prioritization: Helios is a paying onboarding-tier prospect. Let's mark as P1 for now. Also need legal signoff for license before we start ingesting weights.
Sam (swe): S3 path received from customer: s3://helios-models/phoenix-30b/weights.tar.gz. License file included (Apache-2.0). I'll fetch to staging.
CI-bot: Download job started: job_id=ci-7421; status=running.
Mia (applied-ml): For quant pipeline, recommend starting with these flags: 
```
python quantize.py --model-path /staging/phoenix-30b --method gptq --bits 8 --perchannel True --group-size 128
```
And evaluate with: 
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model phoenix-30b-int8 --tasks qa,extraction --num-threads 4 --batch-size 1
```
Sam (swe): On staging node (a100-80g), fp16 p50 ~170ms for single-turn (batch=1) using our runtime v2.3. Will run GPTQ now.
CI-bot: Download job complete: job_id=ci-7421; artifact=/staging/phoenix-30b/weights.tar.gz; checksum=sha256:6b8e...
Sam (swe): GPTQ run done. Notes: INT8 size reduced ~2.9x. Preliminary perf p50=95ms, p95=220ms (batch=1). Observed some tokenization differences causing minor output shift on 6/200 QA prompts.
Mia (applied-ml): Good numbers on latency. Can you push a sample of the outputs to the eval harness so I can compute EM/F1 deltas? Use eval tag phoenix‑int8‑2025‑10‑02.
Sam (swe): Pushed outputs to /eval-results/phoenix-int8-2025-10-02.jsonl. Also added logs: /eval-logs/gptq-run-1749001234.log
Mia (applied-ml): Quick summary from the QA harness: 
- redwood-13b-v1 EM: 68.2, phoenix-30b-fp16 EM: 73.5, phoenix-30b-int8 EM: 72.1 -> delta vs baseline (redwood-13b): +3.9 EM absolute. Delta fp16->int8 = -1.4 EM (~1.9% relative).
- Extraction F1: redwood-13b-v1=0.81, phoenix-30b-fp16=0.86, phoenix-30b-int8=0.82 -> int8 within 1pt of fp16, still +0.01 vs baseline.
- Hallucination probe: phoenix-int8 had 4 cases (of 200) with truncated answers where fp16 had correct; samples logged.
Mia (applied-ml): These look within our regression guardrails (EM drop <3% relative vs fp16; vs redwood-13b net improvement). Recommend proceeding to safety checks and longer-run stability tests (prompt parroting, repeated context).
Alex (customer-success): Helios will need a short report on accuracy and the expected latency numbers for their infra. Also confirm KMS flow.
Jordana (product): Action items: 
- Legal to confirm license OK (assigned to Legal)
- Mia to run full safety suite + stability (ETA 48h)
- Sam to produce production container and docs for KMS integration (ETA 72h)
- Eng-ops to schedule private deployment staging window (ask infra)
Marking thread as P1 intake. I'll file an intake ticket in Jira and tag this thread. :white_check_mark:
Sam (swe): Noted. If safety flags show anything concerning, we'll pause. Otherwise will start building image.
CI-bot: Created ticket JIRA-ML-4521 (model-onboard: phoenix-30b).
Mia (applied-ml): Will share interim eval CSVs once safety run finishes.
Jordana (product): Thanks everyone. If anything blocks legal or infra, ping me. :pray:
Alex (customer-success): I'll update Helios with today's progress and highlight early perf numbers (p50=95ms int8 on A100).
Mia (applied-ml): Posting final note when stability/evals complete.
